title: The customer report stays correct when regenerated or republished
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work orders - View' and 'Settings - Service'.
  2. A completed inspection with a generated report; the ability to regenerate the report and to republish the template.
custom_steps:
1. Regenerate the report and confirm a new version is produced rather than replacing the previous one, every link resolves to the most recent, and earlier versions remain retrievable so a report already handed to a customer cannot change.
2. Republish the template and confirm an existing report is unaltered and the inspection keeps the template version it ran on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Regenerating a report produces a new version rather than replacing the previous one, every link resolves to the most recent, and earlier versions remain retrievable so a report already handed to a customer cannot change.
  • Republishing the template does not alter an existing report, and the inspection keeps the template version it ran on.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9111 (S13 — Customer-facing inspection report); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S13; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R12: “Regenerating a report will produce a new version rather than replacing the previous one, and every link will resolve to the most recent. Earlier versions remain retrievable as the record of what was sent, so a report already handed to a customer cannot change”
  • S13-R13: “Republishing the template will not alter an existing report, and the inspection will keep the template version it ran on”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
